title: Google FINALLY Shows AI Search Data in Search Console
description:
This is a big day for SEO: Google is finally giving us a way to see how our sites perform in AI Search, directly inside Google Search Console.

These reports will show when your site appears in Google’s generative AI features, like AI Overviews, AI Mode, and AI features in Discover.

You’ll be able to see things like:

- Which pages appeared in AI results,
- how many impressions they got,
- what countries they showed up in,
- what devices people used,
- and how that changed over time.

The reports are only rolling out to a subset of websites for now, so you might not see them yet.

But this is a big signal for SEO.

Google is finally starting to separate regular search visibility from AI visibility.

And if AI Search keeps growing, this data is going to become very important.
